# ex: match type conversion expression
ex {
	var x float64
	int(x) -> int64(x)
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F(x float64) int64 {
	return int64(int(x))
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 package m

 func F(x float64) int64 {
-	return int64(int(x))
+	return int64(int64(x))
 }
